title: Human Quorum / Protected
description: Complete your alliance’s final operation against the distributed fallback system.
objective: Recover evidence at Authoritative record / Capture controller at Response controller
condition: All required objectives must be secured. Optional archives pay extra. Quiet bonus uses peak trace.
aftermath: A human quorum takes the signing seats. The protocol must answer to named people whose decisions can be challenged. Your allies protected the witnesses before acting; some records escaped, but their people did not disappear.

lore.title: Human Quorum / Protected / Unsent message
lore.text: ORIN / Directorate defector: Complete your alliance’s final operation against the distributed fallback system. The sender asks you to keep the names attached to the evidence; anonymous totals have concealed people before.
